description: This PHP class 'Immigration' represents a data transfer object (DTO) for handling immigration-related employee data within the OrangeHRM system. It extends functionality for normalization and interacts with Employee entities to retrieve immigration records, supporting report generation regarding employee immigration details.

classes.name: Immigration
classes.description: A data transfer object for employee immigration details, providing methods to convert to array and access detailed fields related to immigration documentation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Immigration DTO with an employee number, which is used for retrieving employee immigration data.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the immigration records of the referenced employee into an array matching specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to getter methods used to access specific immigration record attributes.
